description: This source file defines the class MigraDocPrintDocument, a specialized PrintDocument for rendering MigraDoc documents. It manages printing setup, page rendering, and integrates with MigraDoc's DocumentRenderer to print document pages with custom settings.

classes.name: MigraDocPrintDocument
classes.description: A custom PrintDocument class tailored for printing MigraDoc documents, handling page setup, rendering, and print event management.
